g.text: Bulk expression effects across statistical methods
Same original samples; every method uses the full 4,228-target contrast family.
A: filled circles indicate q < 0.05. B: all 4,228 tests per method; higher curves indicate stronger evidence. Baseline is q=1.
C: 21,368 shared finite gene effects; white bins contain no observations. Axes show log2 effects from -4 to +4.
